description: The Financial Advisory team at Forvis Mazars had the pleasure of supporting the Antama Group in the sale of its stake in Walke AG, a specialist in paper, cardboard and thermoformed packaging, to the Peyer Group. Present at every stage of the process, our team applied its expertise to contribute to the success of this transaction. The Antama Group , an industrial group based in Fribourg, holds several participations in companies active in the industrial and real estate sectors in Switzerland, Italy, and Germany. Walke AG , a specialist in paper packaging, also offers customised solutions in cardboard and thermoforming. Based in Herisau (SG) and founded in 1881, the company employs around twenty people and is recognised as a leading player in paper packaging in Switzerland. The acquisition of Walke AG by the Peyer Group , also a specialist in customised packaging, marks a strategic milestone that will enable the company to continue its development while remaining committed to innovative and environmentally responsible solutions. Antama Group entrusted the Financial Advisory team at Forvis Mazars, composed of David Maquelin and Mikael Augusto , to support them throughout this transaction.

title: Forvis Mazars acted as M&A Lead Advisor to Auto Kunz AG shareholders in the successful sale to Gross Garage Group
description: The Financial Advisory Team in Zurich successfully advised the Kunz brothers as exclusive M&A and holistic financial advisors in the execution of the ownership succession at Auto Kunz AG. As part of the succession plan, the long-established and successful Swiss family business will be taken over in its entirety by the Gross Garage Group with retroactive effect from 1 January 2026. The project team consists of: Finance : Patrik Kerler, Nicolas Salle, Arber Neziri, Philipp Rajewski. Congratulations to everyone involved on completing this successful transaction!

title: Forvis Mazars appointed by the shareholders of Boissec SA
description: The Financial Advisory team at Forvis Mazars was pleased to assist the shareholders of Boissec SA, a company active in the wood industry, with the sale of the business to a group of private investors. Present at every stage, the Forvis Mazars team provided its expertise to successfully complete the sale of the company. Boissec SA , specializing in the trade of wood products for both professionals and private customers, has been established in the Lausanne region since 1968. With around twenty skilled employees, it stands as a leading player in French-speaking Switzerland. The acquisition by a group of private investors marks an important milestone for Boissec SA , which will continue its development while staying true to its core values: quality, craftsmanship, and commitment to its clients and partners. The shareholders entrusted the Financial Advisory team at Forvis Mazars, composed of Antonio Rubino and David Maquelin , to guide them throughout this transaction.

title: Forvis Mazars advised Veolia on the acquisition of Evatherm Group
description: The Veolia Group has acquired Evatherm, a Swiss engineering company specializing in industrial evaporation and crystallization solutions. The Forvis Mazars teams in Switzerland assisted the buyers with financial and legal due diligence, drafting the SPA, and managing the Closing. The Veolia Group has finalized the acquisition of the Evatherm Group, a Swiss engineering company specializing in industrial evaporation and crystallization solutions. This strategic transaction enables the buyers to strengthen their presence in this sector and to enhance the value of an iconic asset with strong international appeal. The Veolia Group called on the Financial Advisory and Legal teams at Forvis Mazars: for the Financial Due Diligence : Antonio Rubino, Pierre Aubrun and Pierre Kalamarides, for the Legal Due Diligence , drafting of the SPA and management of the Closing: Nathalie Schmid-Bessard.

title: Forvis Mazars advised a group of private investors on the acquisition of the Hotel de Verbier
description: A group of private investors has acquired the Hotel de Verbier, a recently renovated 4-star hotel ideally located in the heart of the resort. The Forvis Mazars teams in Switzerland advised the buyers on the financial and tax due diligence. A group of private investors has finalized the acquisition of the Hotel de Verbier , a recently renovated 4-star hotel ideally located in the heart of the Swiss resort of Verbier. This strategic transaction enables the buyers to strengthen their presence in the Alpine hotel sector and to enhance the value of an iconic asset with strong international appeal. The group of private investors called on the Financial Advisory and Tax teams at Forvis Mazars: for Financial Due Diligence : Antonio Rubino, Pierre Aubrun and Pierre Kalamarides. for Tax Due Diligence : Ludovic Pasche and Dorian Trevisan.

title: The Financial Advisory team at Forvis Mazars supported Main Capital Partners in its majority investment in Polypoint AG.
description: Main Capital Partners has announced a majority investment in Polypoint AG. The Financial Advisory team at Forvis Mazars supported Main Capital Partners in the process. Main Capital Partners acquired a majority stake in Polypoint AG , a trusted provider of workforce management software for the healthcare sector. The Financial Advisory team at Forvis Mazars assisted Main Capital Partners by conducting the financial due diligence. The project team consists of: Finance : Patrik Kerler, Nicolas Salle, Marcel Püttmann, Arber Neziri

title: Forvis Mazars supported Coptain (formerly Getting Digit Sàrl) in the majority acquisition of the Noos Global group
note: Majority stake; Coptain formerly Getting Digit Sàrl
description: Coptain (formerly Getting Digit Sàrl), a company specializing in supporting organizations in their digital transformation and sustainability journeys, has acquired a majority stake in the Noos Global group. The Financial Advisory and Tax teams at Forvis Mazars supported Coptain (formerly Getting Digit Sàrl) with financial, tax and social due diligence as well as buy-side M&A advisory. Getting Digit, an expert in the digitalization of complex processes and CSR support, is evolving to become Coptain . Its platform enables organizations to transform their sustainability, certification, or internal transformation initiatives into personalized, engaging, and measurable journeys. Coptain makes sustainability and performance initiatives more accessible and tangible, combining technology, advisory services, and positive impact. As part of this transformation, Noos Global —a recognized group for its ability to engage employees around impact-driven projects and CSR strategies—joins Coptain. This combination creates a leading player in sustainable organizational transformation, uniting digital solutions, employee engagement, and strategic advisory. Coptain engaged the Financial Advisory and Tax teams of Forvis Mazars: for Financial Due Diligence : Antonio Rubino, Pierre Aubrun, and Hugo Badina (Switzerland) for Tax Due Diligence : Manon Ott (France), Eleonore Guesnerot (France), and Miguel Angel Araque (Spain) for Social Due Diligence : Manon Ott (France), Eleonore Guesnerot (France), and Raquel González Castiñeira (Spain)

target: Christian Cavegn Group temperature-controlled transport business
title: Forvis Mazars advised Stef Group
note: Stef Switzerland is a subsidiary of Stef Group
description: Stef Switzerland, subsidiary of Stef Group - European leader specializing in the logistics and transport of food products, has acquired the transport on regulated temperature activity of Christian Cavegn Group, a Swiss family-owned Group, to strengthen its position on the Swiss market. The Financial Advisory and Tax teams at Forvis Mazars assisted Stef Group in conducting the financial, tax and social due diligence for this acquisition The Forvis Mazars Financial Advisory and Tax teams have the pleasure of advising Stef Group, the European leader in temperature-controlled logistics, on its acquisition of the transport on regulated temperature activity of Christian Cavegn Group through its subsidiary Stef Switzerland . Stef Switzerland, subsidiary of Stef Group - specializing in the logistics and transports of food products in Europe, with a presence in 8 countries across Europe and a team of 25,000 employees, has acquired the transport on regulated temperature activity of Christian Cavegn Group. This Swiss family-owned group operates across Switzerland with 450 employees and a fleet of 400 vehicles, with an expertise in the transport of fresh and regulated-controlled food products. This strategic acquisition enables Stef Group, and in particular Stef Switzerland to strengthen its footprint in Switzerland and across Europe by offering a broader range of transport and logistics services. Stef Group engaged the Forvis Mazars Financial Advisory and Tax teams: for financial Due Diligence : Antonio Rubino, Pierre Aubrun, Arber Neziri and Pierre Kalamarides for tax Due Diligence : André Kuhn, Caryl Neuenschwander, Yann Waeber and Steven Grudendel for social Due Diligence : Murielle Kammermann, Dorian Trevisan et Enes Jashari

title: The Financial and Tax Advisory teams at Forvis Mazars supported Eqwal Group in the acquisition of SKS Roltec
description: Eqwal Group has acquired SKS Roltec. The Financial and Tax Advisory teams at Forvis Mazars supported Eqwal Group in this acquisition. Eqwal Group , a global player in the field of custom orthopaedic device, has acquired SKS Roltec, a Swiss and Danish provider of high-end power wheelchairs. The Financial and Tax Advisory teams at Forvis Mazars assisted Eqwal Group by advising on the transaction process and by conducting financial and tax due diligence services. The project team consists of : Finance : Patrik Kerler, Nicolas Salle Tax : André Kuhn, Caryl Neuenschwander

title: Forvis Mazars appointed by Valcalorie SA shareholders
note: Sellers: Stéphane Gaillard and other shareholders
description: Valcalorie SA, a company specialising in the installation of ventilation, heating, and sanitary systems, has joined the Hälg Group, a family-owned business focused on building technology. The financial advisory teams at Forvis Mazars supported Mr. Stéphane Gaillard and the other shareholders of Valcalorie SA throughout every stage of the process, providing their expertise to successfully complete this strategic transaction. Valcalorie SA operates across the entire lifecycle of HVAC systems – from planning through to maintenance – and offers tailored services for various types of facilities. Established in Sion in 1965 and backed by a team of 30 skilled employees, Valcalorie SA has become a trusted and essential service provider in the Valais region. Hälg Group is a Swiss family-owned company specialising in building technology and integrated Facility Management, employing over 1,240 staff across 28 locations throughout Switzerland. The acquisition of Valcalorie SA by Hälg Group represents a strategic milestone for both companies: Hälg Group enters the Valais market and continues its strategy of sustainable growth, while Valcalorie SA gains the support of a strong partner to further develop its business with enhanced resources and expertise. The shareholders of Valcalorie SA engaged the financial advisory team at Forvis Mazars – comprising Samuel Romailler, Emilien Isakov, and Neziha Halilovikj – to support them throughout the project.

title: Forvis Mazars supported HR Path in the acquisition of smahrt consulting AG
description: HR Path has acquired smahrt consulting AG. The financial advisory and tax teams at Forvis Mazars supported HR Path in this acquisition. HR Path , a leading global provider of HR consulting and HR information systems, has acquired smahrt consulting AG , a Swiss-based company specialising in HR-IT consulting, implementation and outsourcing. The financial and tax advisory teams at Forvis Mazars supported HR Path in conducting the financial and tax due diligence. Our experts assisted HR Path by advising on the transaction process and by conducting financial and tax due diligence services. The project team consisted of: For the financial due diligence: Patrik Kerler, Nicolas Salle, Arber Neziri and Philipp Rajewski For the tax due diligence: André Kuhn, Caryl Neuenschwander, Mira Bekcic and Dominique Roggo

title: Forvis Mazars supported Descours & Cabaud in the acquisition of Bachofen AG
description: Descours & Cabaud has acquired Bachofen AG. The financial advisory and tax teams at Forvis Mazars assisted Descours & Cabaud in this acquisition. Descours & Cabaud , leader in professional distribution in France and a major player in Europe, has acquired Bachofen AG , a Swiss supplier and manufacturer of globally leading industrial automation products. The financial advisory and tax teams at Forvis Mazars assisted Descours & Cabaud by advising on the transaction process and by conducting financial and tax due diligence services. The project team consisted of: For the financial due diligence: Patrik Kerler, Nicolas Salle, Pierre Aubrun and Marcel Püttmann For the tax due diligence: André Kuhn and Caryl Neuenschwander

title: Forvis Mazars assisted the Alixio Group in the acquisition of von Rundstedt
description: Alixio Group, France's leading HR services provider, has acquired von Rundstedt. The financial advisory teams at Forvis Mazars assisted Alixio in conducting financial and tax due diligence for this acquisition. The Alixio Group , leader in HR consulting and services in France with over 90 regional offices, has acquired von Rundstedt & Partner Switzerland Ltd . The latter specialises in outplacement and employability services, and currently employs more than 100 staff members across ten sites, assisting some 2,500 people each year with their career reorientation. This strategic expansion enables the Alixio Group to become the Swiss leader in high-value-added HR consulting and services, and to strengthen its European position. The Alixio Group engaged the financial advisory team at Forvis Mazars: • For the financial due diligence: Antonio Rubino, Pierre Aubrun, Hugo Badina and Neziha Halilovikj • For the tax due diligence: Ludovic Pasche, Dorian Trévisan and Sara Tosic-Peev

title: Forvis Mazars supported the Alixio Group in the acquisition of OTP Group
description: Alixio Group, France's leading HR services provider, has acquired OTP Group. The financial advisory teams at Forvis Mazars assisted Alixio in conducting financial and tax due diligence for this acquisition. The Alixio Group , leader in HR consulting and services in France with over 90 offices, has acquired OTP , an expert in outplacement, employability and HR consulting, also recognised for its knowhow in assessment, coaching and support on the job market. Backed by 30 years of expertise, OTP brings together over 80 specialists at 9 sites in Switzerland, offering customised solutions to individuals, teams and companies. This strategic expansion enables the Alixio Group to become the Swiss leader in high-value-added HR consulting and services, and to strengthen its European position. The Alixio Group engaged the financial advisory team at Forvis Mazars: • For the financial due diligence: Antonio Rubino, Pierre Aubrun and Elliot Iseli • For the tax due diligence: Ludovic Pasche, Dorian Trévisan and Sara Tosic-Peev

title: Forvis Mazars supported the ELIS Group in the acquisition of Wäscherei Bodensee AG
description: ELIS Group, leader in circular services, has acquired Wäscherei Bodensee AG. The Financial advisory team at Forvis Mazars assisted ELIS in conducting financial advisory support for this acquisition. The ELIS Group , global leader in circular services with a presence in 29 countries and a team of 52,000 employees, has acquired Wäscherei Bodensee AG . The company operates two laundries, in Münsterlingen and Pfaffnau. It employs 220 people and generated sales of c. 27 million of euros in 2024. This strategic acquisition enables ELIS Switzerland to strengthen its position as the leading provider of circular services by serving more customers in the healthcare and hospitality sectors. ELIS Group engaged the Forvis Mazars Financial advisory team for financial advisory support, composed of Patrik Kerler, Pierre Aubrun, and Nicolas Salle.

title: Forvis Mazars supported SGS Group in the acquisition of CertX
description: SGS Group, a global leader in inspection and certification based in Geneva, has acquired CertX. The Financial advisory team at Forvis Mazars supported SGS Group by conducting financial and tax due diligence. SGS Group , a global leader in inspection and certification based in Geneva, with a presence in 119 countries through a network of over 2,700 laboratories and nearly 100,000 employees, has acquired the Fribourg-based company CertX . This start-up, founded in 2018 as a spin-off from the University of Fribourg, specialises as an inspection and certification body in the fields of cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI), and functional safety. This strategic acquisition enables SGS Group to strengthen its leadership in high-assurance cybersecurity and artificial intelligence certifications, aligning with its "Strategy 27" plan, while expanding development opportunities within its global "Digital Trust" portfolio. The SGS Group appointed the Forvis Mazars Financial advisory team: • for the financial due diligence: Antonio Rubino, Pierre Aubrun and Pierre Kalamarides • for the tax due diligence: Ludovic Pasche

title: Forvis Mazars supported Artefact Group in the acquisition of Effixis
description: European group Artefact, specialising in data and artificial intelligence (AI) consulting, has acquired Effixis. The Financial advisory and the Tax team at Forvis Mazars assisted Artefact in conducting the financial, tax, and social due diligence for this acquisition. The Artefact Group, specialising in data and AI consulting with a presence in 23 countries and a team of 1,500 employees, acquired Effixis. This company has been experiencing strong growth over the past two years, having focused on consulting in generative AI innovations, notably with the launch of its "Prompt University" in 2023. This strategic acquisition enables Artefact Group to strengthen its presence in Europe with two new offices in Switzerland and Belgium. It also enhances its expertise in AI-related services, such as « Natural Language Processing » and « Large Language Models ». Artefact Group appointed the Forvis Mazars Financial advisory team: for the financial due diligence: Antonio Rubino, Pierre Aubrun, Pierre Kalamarides and Régine Chaperon for the tax and social due diligence: Ludovic Pasche, Emina Selimovic and Enes Jashari

title: Forvis Mazars appointed by DatArt SA shareholders
description: DatArt SA, specialising in SAP ERP, has joined forces with API Assistance Professionnelle Informatique SA, which focuses on IT solutions and digital transformation. Forvis Mazars supported the shareholders of DatArt SA throughout the process, providing valuable expertise for this transaction. DatArt SA is a digital services company specialising in consulting, project management, and the maintenance of SAP software and Microsoft solutions. With a team of around fifteen professionals, the company is well-established in the market and boasts recognised technical expertise through a team of experienced SAP consultants. The acquisition by API Assistance Professionnelle Informatique SA enables DatArt SA to strengthen its capacity for continued growth and to further enhance the excellence of its services. This acquisition marks a new milestone in API's development strategy. The shareholders of DatArt SA called on the Forvis Mazars Financial advisory team, composed of Antonio Rubino and Adrian Randall, to support them throughout the project.

title: Forvis Mazars appointed by ADEFI SA shareholders
description: ADEFI SA, which specialises in the installation of sprinkler systems, has joined forces with Enki Capital SA, a Private Equity fund dedicated to Swiss SMEs. Forvis Mazars assisted Mrs Monique Ciocca and Mr Luc Ciocca (ADEFI SA shareholders) throughout the process, providing valuable expertise for this transaction. ADEFI SA is active in the field of fire safety, offering a complete range of services covering all stages of the sprinkler system installation process. With a workforce of around twenty, the company is strongly established in the market and is one of the leaders in Western Switzerland. Enki Capital's acquisition marks a new stage in ADEFI SA’s development strategy. This transaction will enable the company to enjoy the support of operational and strategic experts as it continues its strong growth. Mr and Mrs Ciocca called on the Forvis Mazars Financial advisory team, comprising Antonio Rubino and Emilien Isakov, to support them throughout the project.

title: Mazars advised Cursus Formation on its merger with Romandie Formation
description: Romandie Formation and Cursus Formation, two renowned names in adult education, sign a strategic partnership to join forces under a single entity. Mazars supported Cursus Formation throughout the project until its conclusion. Romandie Formation , a brand run by the Centre Patronal, and Cursus Formation , which brings together Virgile Formation, CRPM and CRQP, have decided to sign a strategic partnership to combine their skills into a single training organisation within the Centre Patronal. This partnership between two renowned names in adult education marks a major step forward in the development of continuing and higher education in French-speaking Switzerland. The new training centre will meet the quality criteria and expectations of the regional economy. Cursus Formation involved Mazars' Financial advisory team composed of Antonio Rubino and David Maquelin.

target: Biker's Point SA and Motomure SA
title: Mazars appointed by Biker’s Point SA and Motomure SA
description: Mazars advised Biker's Point SA and Motomure SA on their sale to Groupe Maurin, France's 5th largest car distribution group. Mazars handled the entire process, providing expert advice and careful management of the transaction. Biker's Point SA and Motomure SA are the official Harley-Davidson dealerships in the canton of Vaud and the canton of Geneva. With sales offices in Morges and Geneva, the companies employ some forty people and specialise in the sale of Harley-Davidson motorbikes, parts, accessories, clothing and after-sales services. This new acquisition is a further step in the Maurin Group's strategy of consolidation and expansion in neighbouring European countries. This transaction involved Mazars' Financial advisory team composed of Antonio Rubino and Adrian Randall.

title: Mazars advised Vokus Personal AG, a portfolio company of Storskogen Schweiz AG, on its acquisition of Swiss Medical Jobs GmbH
description: Vokus Personal AG acquired Swiss Medical Jobs GmbH, which is active in the field of recruitment services for professionals in the healthcare industry. Mazars conducted financial due diligence services to Vokus Personal AG , a portfolio company of Storskogen Schweiz AG , in relation to its acquisition of Swiss Medical Jobs GmbH . This acquisition was pivotal in augmenting the service spectrum of Vokus, broadening its presence in North-Western Switzerland and simultaneously expanding its service portfolio with the placement of doctors.

title: Mazars appointed by Customs Support Group B.V. for a due diligence
description: Customs Support Group B.V., a leading customs support provider, has acquired Zollimpex AG, a customs clearance service provider based in Switzerland. Mazars was appointed by Customs Support Group B.V. to carry out the financial due diligence on the target. Zollimpex AG is a customs clearance agency formerly owned by BKM Customs & Consulting AG, which provides professional customs clearance support and consultancy services. The company operates five customs offices in the Basel area. This new acquisition is a further step in Customs Support Group B.V. 's strategy of consolidation and expansion in neighbouring European countries. Previously, in November 2021, Mazars advised the company on the acquisition of Balimpex AG, also active in customs clearance and related services in Basel. Customs Support Group B.V. involved Mazars' financial advisory team composed of Antonio Rubino, Adrian Randall and Hugo Badina.

title: Mazars advised Schulthess Maschinen AG on its acquisition of Solasa Group, a leading supplier of household appliances
description: Schulthess Maschinen AG acquired Solasa Group, which is specialising in the sale, rental and maintenance of laundry equipment, and other long-living household products across Switzerland. Mazars provided financial due diligence, tax, IT and environmental services to Schulthess , in relation to their acquisition of Solasa Group , which consisted of seven entities located in Switzerland. The acquisition of Solasa Group was pursued as the product portfolio of Solasa Group aligned well with Schulthess’ strategy and offered multiple synergy potentials. Schulthess Maschinen AG was advised by the Mazars team composed of Fabian Sigron and Nicolas Knechtle (financial advisory), Caryl Neuenschwander, Mira Bekcic and Dominique Roggo (tax), Philipp Löffler (IT) and Véronique Veyrassat and Céline Girard (environmental).

title: Mazars appointed by the EIM Group on its acquisition of Magnalia
description: Mazars advised the EIM Group on its acquisition of Magnalia, a leading senior interim management group in the DACH region, consisting of GroNova AG and Management Angels GmbH. Mazars provided M&A advisory and financial due diligence services to EIM , in which idiCo holds a minority stake, related to its acquisition of Magnalia, which consisted of two entities. The acquisition of Magnalia represents a key step towards the creation of a leading position in the DACH region and a first strategic milestone of EIM’s buy-and-build strategy. EIM was advised by the Mazars team composed of Fabian Sigron, Constantin Lanz and Nicolas Knechtle (financial advisory).

title: Mazars appointed by Rhône Color SA shareholder
note: Joins forces with Matériaux PLUS SA within the Proz Group
description: Rhône Color SA, which specialises in the manufacture and distribution of paints and plasters for the industrial and construction sectors in the Valais region, is joining forces with Matériaux PLUS SA, a building materials trading company belonging to the Proz Group. Mazars assisted Mr. Christophe Müller and Rhône Color SA in this project. Rhône Color SA and Matériaux PLUS SA join forces to form the Proz Group. The aim of this alliance is to complement the range of building materials offered by the Group's companies, while developing synergies. The vision shared by Christophe Müller and the Proz family to offer a range of quality products and services is the foundation of this alliance. The continuity of services and the development of Rhône Color SA are assured within the Proz Group. Mr. Müller called on the financial advisory team, comprising Jacques Berger and David Maquelin, to support him throughout the project.

title: Mazars appointed by De Bethune SA for a financial and tax due diligence
note: Majority stake in the assets of REUGE SA
description: The Swiss watch manufacturer De Bethune SA has completed the acquisition of a majority stake in the assets of REUGE SA, a historical manufacturer of mechanical music boxes and music automatons. Mazars has been mandated by De Bethune SA to perform the financial and tax due diligence of the target. REUGE SA is the world's leading producer of contemporary musical automatons, developed with ever more innovative materials, techniques and themes. At the level of De Bethune SA , this acquisition is intended to consolidate its position in the field of craftsmanship and manufacturing. The company will be able to develop synergies by benefiting from the know-how of REUGE SA's master mechanics to expand and renew its offer. De Bethune SA was advised by the Mazars team composed of Antonio Rubino, Matthieu Christen and Adrian Randall for the financial part and Emina Selimovic and Isabelle Bugnon for the tax part.

title: Mazars appointed by Union Bancaire Privée SA for an exclusive private market transaction
note: Sale and lease-back of hospital buildings (real estate financing)
description: Union Bancaire Privée SA (UBP) and The Risk Management Group (Suisse) S.A. have co-advised in the structuring of the sale and lease-back of the buildings of Hôpital de La Tour located in Meyrin (Geneva), the largest autonomous hospital operator in Switzerland. Mazars was mandated by UBP for the financial due diligence of the target. The buildings of Hôpital de La Tour consist of approximately 21,000 sqm of total rentable area serving a total of 400,000 outpatient visits and 8,000 inpatient admissions per year. The purpose of the transaction is to finance the project to create a major healthcare campus in Meyrin. As such, UBP and RMG have brought together a limited number of pension funds, institutional clients and family offices in French-speaking Switzerland to partake in the agreed CHF 500 million transaction. The client called upon the financial advisory team composed of Antonio Rubino and Matthieu Christen to perform the due diligence work on the financial aspects.

title: Mazars appointed as exclusive M&A sell-side lead advisor to Simulands on capital raise
note: Funding round: SHS Capital took a minority stake in Simulands
description: Simulands, a leading provider of medical simulation training equipment in the field of structural cardiac interventions, sold a minority share to SHS Capital in its latest funding round of EUR 10.0m. Simulands is thus well prepared to accelerate the commercialisation of its simulators and their education and training services in the cardiovascular field for physicians. Mazars provided exclusive M&A sell-side lead advisory services and financial modelling services to Simulands in relation to its latest funding round of EUR 10 million in exchange for an equity stake in the company. Simulands was advised by the financial advisory team of Mazars in Switzerland.

title: Genfit SA appointed Mazars to perform the financial, tax and social due diligence of Versantis AG
description: French biopharmaceutical company Genfit SA (Nasdaq and Euronext: GNFT), which specialises in improving the lives of patients with severe chronic liver diseases, has completed the acquisition of Versantis AG. Mazars was mandated for the financial, tax and social due diligence of the target. At the level of Genfit SA , this acquisition aims to consolidate its position in the field of acute and chronic liver failure (ACLF) through the integration of a clinically advanced asset (VS-01) with a solid scientific rationale supported by encouraging Phase 1b and preclinical data. Additionally, Genfit SA will also expand its pipeline in other liver diseases with significant unmet medical needs through other product candidates developed by Versantis AG. Genfit SA was advised by a Mazars team composed of Baudouin Heron and Antonio Rubino for the financial part and Murielle Kammermann and Isabelle Bugnon for the tax and social part.

title: Galbraith’s Overseas Holdings Limited appointed Mazars to perform the financial and tax due diligence of Ifchor group
description: Ifchor group is an international shipping brokerage company with 17 entities worldwide. Mazars was involved in the merger of Galbraith's Overseas Holdings Limited and Ifchor group. The merger of the international shipping brokers Ifchor and Galbraith's aims to remain competitive in the shipping business by continuing to jointly develop their global presence. Mazars was mandated by Galbraith's to perform the due diligence of three entities of the Ifchor group (including the holding company and the Swiss operating company) on tax and financial aspects. Mazars involved a large team on this project led by Giuseppe Sottile and Ludovic Pasche (tax) and by Antonio Rubino and Baudouin Heron (financial advisory).

title: Mazars assisted Blanc SA in a Family Buy-Out transaction
note: Family buy-out by the fourth generation
description: Blanc SA, specialised in maintenance and cleaning services, has finalised its Family Buy-Out. Mazars was mandated to proceed with the valuation of the company and to assist the shareholders in their transmission. The shareholders of Blanc SA have decided to pass on the family business. The fourth generation of entrepreneurs has entered the capital for the first time in the history of the company. In this context, Mazars assisted the stakeholders in the valuation of the company, the strategy, the execution and the closing of the transaction. Blanc SA was advised by the Mazars team composed of Matthieu Christen, Adrian Randall and Antonio Rubino (financial advisory).

title: Mazars appointed by Stadtcasino Baden AG
note: Mandate was financial modelling; text names Casinò Locarno as newly acquired
description: Stadtcasino Baden AG appointed Mazars in relation to financial modelling tasks for their business operations, including their newly acquired entity Casinò Locarno. Mazars provided financial modelling services to Stadtcasino Baden AG for multiple entities with numerous profit centres. The modelling services were provided to simulate multiple business cases and to be able to make data-driven decisions. Mazars’ financial advisory team provided financial modelling services to Stadtcasino Baden AG.

title: Mazars assisted Floween SAS in the acquisition of the call center Teleactis Telepro SA
note: Bought 100% of the shares from CEO Mr. Tronchin
description: Floween SAS mandated Mazars to conduct a search and identify companies specialised in customer relationship management. Subsequently, Mazars supported the client throughout the acquisition process of Teleactis Telepro SA until the signature and the conclusion of the transaction. Floween SAS decided to further strengthen its position in the Swiss customer experience market with the acquisition of 100% of the shares of Mr. Tronchin, CEO of Teleactis Telepro SA , in October 2022. Mazars was involved in the project by identifying the company, making the initial contact and the first discussions, then carrying out the financial due diligence and the tax review of the target. Finally, Mazars also provided support in the negotiations and the signature until the closing of the transaction. Floween SAS was advised by Antonio Rubino and Baudouin Heron of the financial advisory team and by Ludovic Pasche of the tax team.

title: Mazars appointed by MYTY Group
description: MYTY Group acquired Monami Group, which is active in the field of online and digital consulting. Mazars provided financial due diligence services to MYTY Group in relation to their acquisition of Monami Group, which consisted of three entities, of which two were located in Switzerland and one in Germany. The acquisition of Monami Group was an add-on acquisition to MYTY Group AG, which is a portfolio company of Ufenau Capital Partners AG. MYTY Group was advised by Mazars’ financial advisory team.

title: Mazars mandated by Axpo for the sale of wind farms
note: Second deal on the page: Axpo sold its 46% stake in La Peñuca to Cubico
description: Axpo sold its onshore wind farms in Spain and Italy, in order to keep their portfolio of wind and photovoltaic assets in line with their strategy. Mazars provided exclusive M&A sell-side services to Axpo in relation to their sale of two onshore wind farms, (i) the wind farm in Bisaccia (Italy) – one of the country’s leading utilities – and (ii) La Peñuca (Spain) – one of the world’s largest privately-owned renewable energy companies. Axpo sold its 100% shareholding in the Bisaccia wind farm to Edison S.p.A. and its 46% minority stake in the La Peñuca site to Cubico. Axpo was advised by the Mazars’ Financial advisory and global infrastructure finance team and Ben Morris (Mazars, United Kingdom).

title: Mazars advised Schulthess Maschinen AG
description: Schulthess Maschinen AG acquired a majority stake in Chemie AG, which is active in the field of textile-cleaning and -hygiene. The transaction was made to further pursue Schulthess’ one-stop-shop-strategy and to offer additional value to their clients. Mazars provided financial due diligence services to Schulthess Maschinen AG in relation to their acquisition of a majority stake in Chemie AG , which consisted of one entity in Worblaufen, Switzerland. The acquisition of a majority stake in Chemie AG was complementary to the product portfolio of Schulthess Maschinen AG. Schulthess Maschinen AG was advised by Mazars’ financial advisory team.

title: Swiss E-Mobility Group (Switzerland) AG appointed Mazars for the due diligence of Alexand'Ro Edouard'O Passion Vélo Sàrl
description: Swiss E-Mobility Group (Schweiz) AG has mandated Mazars for the financial and tax due diligence of Alexand'Ro Edouard'O Passion Vélo Sàrl, a company specialised in the sale of indoor and outdoor bicycles and skis. The two shareholders of Alexand'Ro Edouard'O Passion Vélo Sàrl have decided to sell their shares to external investors. In this context, Constellation Capital, through the company Swiss E-mobility Group (Schweiz) AG , decided to acquire 100% of the stakes in 2022. Mazars advised the buyer in the financial and tax aspects through a due diligence of the target led by the team composed of Jean Gafan (tax) and of Antonio Rubino and David Maquelin (financial advisory).

title: Mazars performed a financial and tax due diligence for Alphi SAS
note: Client Alphi SAS showed interest; text says Morand Group acquired 100%
description: Alphi SAS has shown a particular interest in the company ADRIA SA, active in the field of shoring and safety on construction sites. Mazars was involved in this project by carrying out the financial and tax due diligence of the target. To carry on with its development in Switzerland, the Savoy-based company Alphi SAS was interested in the company ADRIA SA, expert in shoring and construction equipment. The acquisition was successfully finalised in 2022 with the acquisition of 100% of the target's shares by the Morand Group. The client called upon Mazars to carry out the due diligence work on the financial and tax aspects. The team involved in this project was led by Giuseppe Sottile (tax partner) and Antonio Rubino (financial advisory director).

title: Proventis Partners advised LAS Holding AG on the sale of Pontacol AG to Covestro Deutschland AG
description: On June 23, 2025, LAS Holding AG has signed an agreement to sell Pontacol AG, a Swiss manufacturer of multilayer adhesive films, and its subsidiaries (Pontacol GmbH, Germany and Pontacol Inc., USA) to Covestro Deutschland AG. The two owners of the LAS Holding, Adrian Leumann and Stefan Leumann, explain the move: “Pontacol has a great portfolio of adhesive films and unlimited possibilities for innovation. Leveraging the true potential of this special adhesive technology in today’s political and economic environment is challenging for a mid-size family company like LAS Holding. With Covestro we’ve found a new strong owner who can give Pontacol a new perspective for success, innovation and growth.” “This acquisition is an important milestone in our Specialty Films growth strategy,” says Aukje Doornbos, Head of Business Entity Specialty Films at Covestro. “In recent years, we have already made large investments in expanding our global capacities. With Pontacol, we can strengthen our product development and expand our global offering for our customers. We are particularly looking forward to the approximately 100 experienced employees who will make a valuable contribution to our further growth with their expertise.”

title: Proventis Partners advised Arion Group
note: Transaction led by Didactic; Caring Group formed by Didactic Group and Hygie
description: Arion Group, an owner-managed company based on the border between the Netherlands and Germany, was sold to the French-based Caring Group as part of a strategic transaction led by the French company Didactic. The acquisition aims to further drive international growth and strengthen the group’s position in the global market. With more than 30 years of experience in pioneering and setting trends in the international healthcare market, Arion Group is embarking on the next phase of its journey with strong new partners. With the Didactic Group and Hygie, Arion has formed the Caring Group, a leading player in the healthcare market. Proventis Partners acted as exclusive M&A advisor to the sellers of Arion throughout the entire process. The Proventis Partners transaction team consisted of Dr. Uwe Nickel (Partner), Bartosz Kurkowski (Senior Advisor), Artur Maibach (Vice President) and Flavian Gmünder (Analyst).

title: PROVENTIS PARTNERS advised OnlineDoctor AG
description: OnlineDoctor AG (OD) has been sold to Lohmann & Rauscher (L&R) as part of a successful Exit-Deal. ODs founders and managing directors remain on board working alongside the new owners to implement the company’s long-term strategy and to ensure its continued growth potential. Since its foundation in 2016, OnlineDoctor AG developed from a startup into a leading online dermatology services company in Germany and Switzerland with an outstanding network of over 700 dermatologists and leading health insurance companies. Proventis Partners acted as exclusive M&A advisor to the selling shareholders throughout the entire M&A process. The shareholders consisted of the founders and managing directors Dr. Tobias Wolf and Dr. Philipp Wustrow as well as industry focused venture capital funds and private investors. “Proventis Partners supported the management and deal team throughout the entire M&A process with a high level of expertise and a great deal of sensitivity for the various stakeholders.” says Dr. Philipp Wustrow, OD Cofounder. “The successful Exit will help OD in implementing its long-term strategy to become Europe’s leading tele-dermatology platform.” The transaction team of Proventis Partners consisted of Jan Wetter (Partner, Zurich), Cédric Mutz (Director, Zurich) and Tassilo Pilars de Pilar (Analyst, Zurich).

title: PROVENTIS PARTNERS advised Rhenopharma Group
note: Ambiguous text: Konapharma, Allpack Group AG and Rhenochem AG form Rhenopharma Group; Proventis advised the buyer
description: The acquired Konapharma AG, Allpack Group AG, and Rhenochem AG will form the Rhenopharma Group. As a contract manufacturer in the pharmaceutical industry, Konapharma complements the service offerings of pharmaceutical packaging company Allpack and Rhenochem, both family-owned companies with decades of extensive experience and expertise in the global pharmaceutical industry. The Rhenopharma Group sets new standards in the pharmaceutical industry with its unique integrated end-to-end value chain (Supply Chain as a Service). This innovative concept enables the Group to offer pharmaceutical services to its customers worldwide, ranging from development, procurement, manufacturing and packaging to worldwide distribution. With the strategic expansion to include Konapharma, the Group offers its customers a comprehensive service that increases efficiency and opens up new opportunities in the pharmaceutical industry. Proventis Partners acted as exclusive M&A and financing advisor to the buyer throughout the entire process. The Proventis Partners transaction team consisted of Jan Wetter (Partner), Dr. Christoph Studinka (Partner), Artur Maibach (Vice President) and Flavian Gmünder (Analyst).

title: Proventis Partners advised the Customs Support Group
description: Customs Support, a leading provider of customs services, is pleased to announce the acquisition of Zollimpex. Zollimpex is part of BKM Customs and Consulting AG (BKM), a customs broker and consulting company based in Switzerland. The acquisition of Zollimpex is part of Customs Support’s strategy to strengthen its presence in Switzerland. By adding Zollimpex to its network, Customs Support is positioning itself at strategically central locations in Switzerland and thus also expanding its operational reach in France, Germany and Italy. This strategic move will significantly expand Customs Support’s service portfolio in Switzerland and offer customers an expanded range of modern customs services with a focus on efficiency, digitalization and automation solutions. This fits seamlessly into Customs Support’s comprehensive buy-and-build strategy, which is primarily focused on international expansion in the customs services sector. The main objective of this acquisition is to provide even greater value to Customs Support and Zollimpex’s existing customer base, while retaining the current qualified management and workforce and driving further growth for all stakeholders of both organizations. “We are very pleased to be able to expand and strengthen our presence in Switzerland with the takeover of Zollimpex. With the quality of services it offers its customers, Zollimpex is an excellent fit for Customs Support. This acquisition will enable us to better serve our customers in the region and offer them the best digital customs services. Together we open up new horizons for our customers and continue to advocate for professional, reliable and digital customs clearance on neutral ground.” – Frank Weermeijer – CEO Customs Support “The transition from Zollimpex to Customs Support, the number 1 digital customs partner, opens up new opportunities for our customers and our team. Working with Customs Support allows Zollimpex to strengthen its commitment to providing exceptional customs solutions. With the strategic locations in Switzerland, Zollimpex expands its reach as part of a comprehensive network to streamline, digitize and automate customs services.” – Florian Brecher – BKM Customs & Consulting AG Customs Support is committed to providing the best possible service to its customers and the acquisition of Zollimpex is a testament to this commitment. With the acquisition of Zollimpex, Customs Support is now even better positioned to serve its customers in Switzerland and the surrounding regions.

title: Proventis Partners advised the owners of Heberlein
note: Buyers: Renaissance investment foundation with management and Daniel Lippuner
description: Proventis Partners advised the owner of Heberlein AG on the sale of the company. Heberlein, headquartered in Switzerland, is a leading global provider of ceramic nozzles for synthetic continuous filament yarns. The new owners are the Renaissance investment foundation, the company’s management team and the industry expert Daniel Lippuner. The new owners will continue to run the business with 80 employees as Heberlein Technology AG and want to make a long-term commitment. The Proventis Partners deal team consisted of Dr. Christoph Studinka, Jan Wetter, Artur Maibach and Jonas Hesseldieck.

title: Proventis Partners advised the sellers of F. Hunziker + Co AG
description: F. Hunziker + Co AG, a Swiss family business run by the third generation, has been sold to Amapharm GmbH as part of a succession plan. Amapharm GmbH knows F. Hunziker + Co AG from its many years of co-operation and will work together with the management of F. Hunziker + Co AG to ensure a smooth integration into the Amapharm GmbH Group. In recent years, F. Hunziker + Co AG has developed from a traditional supplier of sweets for the largest Swiss retailers into a specialized global supplier of functional confectionery products such as nutritional supplements and medical nutraceuticals. Due to the increasing demand for nutritional supplements and health-promoting products, Amapharm GmbH has decided to take over the long-standing strategic partner as of January 2024. Proventis Partners acted as exclusive M&A advisor to the sellers throughout the entire process. The Proventis Partners transaction team consisted of Jan Wetter (Partner), Christoph Studinka (Partner), Artur Maibach (Associate) and Flavian Gmünder (Analyst).

title: Proventis Partners advised Sukano
description: Sukano, a leading manufacturer of additive and color masterbatches, is pleased to announce the acquisition of the majority stake in KAYS Kft., a compounder specialized in engineering plastics. This transaction represents a significant milestone for both companies and provides crucial momentum for future growth. The decision to acquire is based on the strategic alignment of both companies and their shared vision for the future. Through this transaction, the parties aim to combine forces and expertise, expressing confidence that this development will contribute to a stronger and more successful organization. Both companies will continue their operations independently, ensuring a seamless transition for all stakeholders involved. Proventis Partners acted as exclusive M&A advisor to the buyers throughout the entire process. The Proventis Partners transaction team consisted of Dr. Uwe Nickel (Partner) and Artur Maibach (Associate).

title: Proventis Partners advised OC Oerlikon
description: OC Oerlikon acquired 100% of hartec Anlagenbau GmbH, a pioneer in PVD coatings.

title: Proventis Partners advised Faude & Huguenin
description: Faude & Huguenin, with two production and sales locations in German-speaking Switzerland and French-speaking Switzerland as well as a production site in India, was looking for a successor solution and at the same time had to be restructured in order to get its EBITDA back on track. Proventis Partners has been engaged to support the restructuring and increase in value. The majority of the company was then sold to Renova AG, a Swiss private equity company.

title: Proventis Partners advised EBM Group
description: The EBM Group has sold its subsidiary EBM Telecom AG to Besonet / Quickline Net AG. The acquisition of EBM Telecom AG continues the consolidation in the Swiss cable network market and the growth of the Quickline Group. The well-positioned provider EBM Telecom thus automatically becomes part of the Quickline group, which already includes 19 independent cable network companies and the full-service provider Finecom. EBM Telecom AG operates as a full service provider in EBM’s extended coverage area. The company covers the telecommunications needs of business and residential customers in a holistic manner and offers a comprehensive portfolio on the largest fiber optic network in the region of northwestern Switzerland, ranging from networking and data transport to secure data storage in its own data centers. The Quickline group is the clear number two in the Swiss cable network market behind upc cablecom. Together with EBM Telecom AG, Finecom Telecommunications AG and 19 independent cable network companies, around 350,000 households in the cantons of Aargau, Baselland, Bern, Graubünden, Lucerne, Nidwalden, Schwyz, Solothurn, Valais, Zug and Zurich will be supplied with Quickline multimedia services from 2014. Finecom, based in Biel, is a subsidiary of the parent company Besonet AG and employs 70 people. Proventis Partners was responsible for evaluating and approaching potential buyers, coordinating due diligence and negotiating the transaction. Proventis’ tasks also included the company valuation and the preparation of recommendations to EBM’s board of directors.

target: Natural Fibers and Textile Components business units
title: Proventis Partners advised OC Oerlikon
description: The Oerlikon Group has signed an agreement with China’s Jinsheng Group to sell the Natural Fibers and Textile Components business units (BUs) of its Textile segment. The sale represents a further strategic step towards optimizing and balancing Oerlikon’s portfolio by significantly reducing the textile-related share of total group sales. OC Oerlikon is one of the world’s leading high-tech industrial groups with over 11,000 employees and more than CHF 2.5 billion in sales. In the textile sector, the Swiss group will now focus on the man-made fibers business. Jinsheng Group is a leading manufacturer of premium CNC machines & tools, textile recycling machines and medical testing equipment. The company operates in four business units: High End Machine & Tools BU, Regenerated Cotton Fiber BU, Real Estate BU and Saliva Based Test BU. Jinsheng Group has annual sales of over RMB 6.6 billion with more than 5,000 employees and 70 subsidiaries worldwide. Proventis Partners acted as exclusive M&A advisor to Oerlikon Group throughout the carve-out process.

title: Proventis Partners advised Datahouse
description: Wüest & Partner, ein Beratungsunternehmen in den Bereichen Immobilien und Standortentwicklung, hat sämtliche Aktien des Technologieanbieters Datahouse AG übernommen. Der Zusammenschluss hat zum Ziel, eine gemeinsame starke Position im Markt für Datenanalyse und Webapplikationen aufzubauen. Die Wüest & Partner AG erhöht mit der Akquisition ihre Initiative in einem für den Immobiliensektor zukunftsträchtigen Bereich. Die Datahouse AG ist ein Spin-off-Unternehmen der ETH Zürich und gehört zu den führenden Anbietern von Daten und Content. Das Unternehmen vereint Statistik-, Technologie- und Managementkompetenz und verfügt über langjährige Erfahrung aus zahlreichen E-Business-Projekten. Wüest & Partner ist ein international tätiges Beratungsunternehmen in den Bereichen Immobilien und Bau sowie Raum- und Standortentwicklung. Ein internationales Netzwerk von Partnerfirmen und regional gut verankerten Fachpersonen vor Ort ergänzt die in Zürich, Genf, Frankfurt und Berlin stationierten Beraterteams. Proventis Partners war für die Evaluation und Ansprache von potentiellen Käufern, für die Koordination der Due Diligence, die Verhandlung des Kaufvertrags, die Unternehmensbewertung und die Erarbeitung von Empfehlungen an den Verwaltungsrat der Datahouse verantwortlich.

title: Proventis Partners advised Datwyler Group
note: Activities of Maagtechnic acquired; title says Proventis advised Datwyler Group, text does not name the seller
description: Eriks Group Germany has acquired the activities of Maagtechnic AG (Switzerland),. With the acquisition of Maagtechnic, Eriks Germany intends to significantly expand its market position and continue on its course of completing its product range and focusing on innovative, technology-oriented market activities. Maagtechnic is a technical trading, manufacturing and service company in six business areas: Elastomer Technology, Plastics Technology, Fluid and Drive Technology, as well as Occupational Health and Safety and Operating Materials. With around 580 employees, Maagtechnic realizes sales of approximately 182.5 million euros. Eriks is regarded as a world-leading and innovative group of technical trading companies, with a wide range of high-quality engineering components as well as technical and logistical services for original equipment and maintenance in all industries. Eriks serves more than 200,000 customers on four continents in 27 countries at more than 300 locations. Proventis Partners acted as exclusive M&A advisor to the Daetwyler Group, owner of Maagtechnik, throughout the transaction process in the sale of the company.

title: Proventis Partners advised Arbonia-Forster Group
note: Former owner (person) reacquired; formerly Hartchrom AG
description: Dr. Edgard Oehler, former owner, has reacquired STI Surface Technologies AG, formerly Hartchrom AG, from AFG Arbonia-Forster-Holding AG. The decision was made by the former owner after AFG decided to sell its automotive, furniture and surface industry divisions. STI Surface Technologies AG develops solutions in the field of surface technology such as galvanic processes, thermal or mechanical coatings. Today, customers from the printing press, paper manufacturing, automotive, engine building, aerospace, marine and general plant engineering sectors count on STI AG’s solutions. Proventis Partners acted as exclusive M&A advisor to Arbonia-Forster-Holding AG during the entire divestment process.

title: Proventis Partners advises the management of the packaging company
note: Strategy consulting for an unnamed packaging company
description: Proventis Partners advised a medium-sized company in the cardboard / paper packaging industry. This involved comprehensive strategy advice and included the aspects of purchasing, sales, market positioning, investments, competition and other areas.

target: Verdol original parts, service and conversion business
title: Proventis Partners advised Saurer AG
note: Bought through Saurer's Allma business unit
description: Sauer’s Allma business unit is taking over the Verdol original parts, service and conversion business from the Reyes Group. The management of Allma expects a new growth impulse for its own business, as the synergies of both companies can be used optimally in this way. All existing customers of Verdol will be served by Allma with immediate effect after the acquisition. The Saurer Group is a leading global textile company focusing on machinery and components for yarn processing. The names Allma and Volkmann stand for excellent twisting machines, Saurer Jintan for expertise in spinning preparation and Saurer Embroidery for competence in embroidery. Reyes Groupe will in future concentrate on its core business in the energy markets. Proventis Partners acted as exclusive M&A advisor to Saurer Group throughout the transaction.

title: Proventis Partners advised EBM Group
note: 23% stake sold to the company's management
description: As part of a management investment, the EBM Group has sold 23% of the shares in the Saphir Group to the company’s management. Saphir Group is a telecommunications and IT infrastructure solutions provider based in Lausen, Switzerland. The company provides broadband networks, network solutions and infrastructure management services through 120 employees and generates revenues of over CHF 25 million. EBM Group is an energy provider for the Basel region and develops energy solutions for more than 170,000 residential and business customers. The company employs more than 550 people and has a turnover of almost 700 million CHF. Proventis Partners acted as exclusive M&A advisor to EBM Group throughout the sale process.

title: Proventis Partners advised Climatex
note: Growth capital via capital increases by BLR & Partners in Climatex AG (fundraising)
description: BLR & Partners invested in Climatex AG in February and April 2017 through two capital increases for its further growth. Proventis Partners advised Climatex.

title: Proventis Partners advised Baschnagel Group
note: MBO by interim managing director; sellers: Baschnagel family shareholders
description: The shareholders of Autocenter Baschnagel have sold 100% of their company shares to the interim managing director, René Fischer, as part of a “Management Buy Out”. Tahe transaction is a succession solution, which gives the more than 90 employees of the company certainty about the future of the company. Due to the large family structure of the owning family Baschnagel, a family-internal company succession had been determined to be too difficult. Proventis Partners supported the succession solution in an advisory capacity.

title: Proventis Partners advised Econis
note: Majority stake; CEO Toni Fuchs also took a stake
description: As part of the succession plan at Econis AG, the Swiss investment foundation Renaissance acquired a majority of the share capital of the IT service provider. At the same time, Toni Fuchs, who had previously been appointed CEO at Econis, took a stake in the company. The reorganization of the ownership structure will enable the company to strengthen its own market position and drive new services in the areas of security and workplace. Econis specializes in cloud and outsourcing services and IT solutions and has an excellent reputation in the Swiss market. Renaissance acts as a partner to Swiss SMEs in financing growth or succession solutions. Renaissance focuses on innovative SMEs with revenues between CHF 20 and CHF 80 million. Proventis Partners advised the existing shareholders and the management of Econis AG in the management of Econis AG as exclusive M&A advisor throughout the entire process.

title: Proventis Partners advised OC Oerlikon
description: Oerlikon Balzers has signed the agreement to acquire the Swedish surface technology provider Primateria. The acquisition will expand and enhance Oerlikon Balzers’ pre- and post-processing technologies and increase its surface treatment portfolio. The acquisition is the next growth step for Oerlikon Balzers in the gear cutting tools market and will also improve the service offering to customers. The expanded service offering will be implemented first in Sweden and later globally. The Swedish company Primateria is a specialist in pre- and post-treatment solutions for tool optimization. OC Oerlikon is one of the world’s leading high-tech industrial groups with over 11,000 employees and more than CHF 2.5 billion in sales. Proventis Partners acted as exclusive M&A advisor to OC Oerlikon throughout the transaction.

title: Proventis Partners advised the FoamPartner Group
description: Conzzeta Group, Switzerland, acquired Otto Bock Kunststoff, domiciled in Duderstadt, Lower Saxony (Germany), for its division FoamPartner. Otto Bock Kunststoff generated net revenue of around EUR 130 million with a profitability that was above-average for Conzzeta. The number of employees at the end of 2016 was around 430 worldwide. otto Bock Kunststoff mainly comprises foams used in the automotive industry as interior linings for vehicles. The production sites taken over in Duderstadt (Germany), Rochester Hills (MI, USA) and Changzhou (China) complemented the existing FoamPartner production sites and broadened the company’s footprint in the designated growth regions. Proventis Partners supported the Conzzeta Group and the FoamPartner Division with the carve-out of Otto Bock Kunststoff from the Otto Bock Group and with the post-merger integration into the FoamPartner Division. This encompassed all aspects from technical carve-out questions to personnel and management questions to the planning and implementation of synergies in the business plan.

title: Proventis Partners advised OMANDA
note: Search for a growth investor; no deal named
description: Proventis Partners advised Omanda AG, a Swiss startup company, in its efforts to find a growth investor. The company’s services include the development, production and distribution of medical products.

title: Proventis Partners advised OC Oerlikon
description: Oerlikon has acquired Sucotec AG, a Swiss manufacturer specializing in CVD (Chemical Vapour Deposition) equipment for the tools market. The acquisition enhances the range of products and services provided by Liechtenstein-based coating specialist Oerlikon Balzers, which focuses on PVD (Physical Vapour Deposition) and PACVD (Plasma Assisted Chemical Vapour Deposition). Day-to-day operations at the existing site, as well as business and collaboration with Sucotec customers and partners, will continue as before under the management of previous CEO Werner Bürgin, now as part of Oerlikon Balzers. Sucotec AG stands out from its competitors primarily through the high quality of its CVD and PACVD coating systems and the outstanding commitment to its customers in all areas, from adaptation to specific customer requirements in the early system development phase through to its after-sales service. OC Oerlikon is one of the world’s leading high-tech industrial groups with over 11,000 employees and more than CHF 2.5 billion in sales. Proventis Partners advised OC Oerlikon Corporation exclusively as transaction advisor on the deal.

title: Proventis Partners advised Sika AG
description: Sika has agreed to acquire Polypag, a leading manufacturer and developer of polyurethane foam systems based in Switzerland. The acquisition will allow Sika to expand its know-how in the development of polyurethane foams, increase its product portfolio and production capacity, and drive its specialty trade business. Polypag is a leading supplier of specialty foam systems and has positioned itself as a strong specialist trade partner with a high-performance product range. Sika is a global specialty chemicals company, a leader in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing and protecting for the construction and automotive industries. Proventis Partners assisted Sika AG in the acquisition of Polypag AG.

title: Proventis Partners advised JOMOS
description: On October 2, VINCI Energies, a VINCI Group division specializing in energy and information and communications technology (ICT), signed an agreement to acquire 100% of the shares of the JOMOS Group, one of Switzerland’s leading fire protection suppliers. The group consists of JOMOS, a technical fire protection company, and EuroSprinkler, a manufacturer of sprinkler products. The group will be integrated into the Fire Protection Solutions Group, making it a wholly owned subsidiary of VINCI Energies. The headquarters in Balsthal will strengthen the Fire Protection Solutions Group’s presence in Switzerland. In a constantly changing world, VINCI Energies focuses on the implementation of new technologies. Two developments are particularly supported: digital transformation and energy transition. Every day, VINCI Energies’ 1,600 regionally based and agile business units increase the reliability, safety and efficiency of energy, transport and communication infrastructures, factories and buildings. Proventis Partners assisted the owners and management teams of both JOMOS and EuroSprinkler throughout the M&A process. Services included preparation of transaction documentation, identification and approach of suitable investors, coordination of due diligence, and commercial negotiation of the transactions.

title: Proventis Partners advised the shareholders of EuroSprinkler
note: Same deal as the JOMOS page; EuroSprinkler is part of JOMOS Group
description: On October 2, VINCI Energies, a VINCI Group division specializing in energy and information and communications technology (ICT), signed an agreement to acquire 100% of the shares of the JOMOS Group, one of Switzerland’s leading fire protection suppliers. The group consists of JOMOS, a technical fire protection company, and EuroSprinkler, a manufacturer of sprinkler products. The group will be integrated into the Fire Protection Solutions Group, making it a wholly owned subsidiary of VINCI Energies. The headquarters in Balsthal will strengthen the Fire Protection Solutions Group’s presence in Switzerland. In a constantly changing world, VINCI Energies focuses on the implementation of new technologies. Two developments are particularly supported: digital transformation and energy transition. Every day, VINCI Energies’ 1,600 regionally based and agile business units increase the reliability, safety and efficiency of energy, transport and communication infrastructures, factories and buildings. Proventis Partners assisted the owners and management teams of both JOMOS and EuroSprinkler throughout the M&A process. Services included preparation of transaction documentation, identification and approach of suitable investors, coordination of due diligence, and commercial negotiation of the transactions.

title: Proventis Partners advised Christian Fischbacher
description: On January 7, 2019, Fremaux Delorme Group, a global manufacturer of bed, bath and table linens, has acquired a majority stake in Christian Fischbacher Bed & Bath AG, a leading Swiss manufacturer of luxury home textiles. The transaction follows a separation process of the bedding and furnishing fabrics businesses already initiated in 2018. The bedding business will now have the opportunity to position its products on the international market as a result of the acquisition. Christian Fischbacher looks back on a company history spanning two centuries. The Swiss brand’s products, designed with passion and extreme attention to detail, are composed of fabrics of the highest quality, characterized by constant innovation and creativity. Fremaux Delorme produces and sells bed, bath and table linen worldwide. The company also operates a textile factory that offers damask designs for mattresses, tablecloths and upholstery fabrics. Fremaux Delorme S.A. was founded in 1845 and is based in Paris, France. Proventis Partners has advised the shareholders and the management team of Christian Fischbacher throughout the entire M&A process. Services provided included the preparation of full transaction documentation, identification and approach of suitable investors, due diligence support and negotiation of the commercial terms of the transaction.

title: Proventis Partners advised Omni Ray
note: Majority stake; MD Roger Müller keeps a minority
description: Proventis Partners advised the shareholders of Omni Ray AG on the sale of a majority stake in Addtech Nordic AB. The managing director of Omni Ray AG, Roger Müller, retains a minority stake in the company. The acquisition strengthens Addtech’s own competencies in the field of automation, which had grown strongly in recent years. As part of the transaction, the buyer is even creating a new Automation business unit, which in future will bundle products and solutions in the fields of automation, robotics, sensor technology, industrial networks, embedded computers and data communications infrastructure. Omni Ray AG is a Zurich-based technical trading company and service provider with a strong position in the Swiss market for automation solutions, focusing mainly on industrial applications, infrastructure, transportation and medicine. Addtech is a technology trading group that provides technological and economic added value in the link between manufacturers and customers. Addtech operates in select market niches for advanced technology products and solutions in the manufacturing and infrastructure industries. Proventis Partners assisted Omni Ray’s owners and management team throughout the M&A process. Services included preparation of transaction documentation, identification and approach of suitable investors, coordination of due diligence, and commercial negotiation of the transaction.

title: Proventis Partners advised Italia Golf & More
description: Proventis Partners acted as exclusive M&A advisor to the owner on the sale of Italia Golf & More to LMX Holding as part of the succession. Italia Golf & More AG (“”IGM””) was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Baar, Switzerland (holding company). IGM is a premium tour operator for golf holidays in Italy with a portfolio of 120 hotels and 100 golf clubs. LMX Holding GmbH is the parent company of the Leipzig tour operator LMX Touristik, founded in 2001 and managed by Markus Hartwig. LMX Touristik also owns the brands LMX Individuell, SunTrips, the Spanish-based LMX Viajes/LMX International as well as the new hotel brand Amarina Hotels & Resorts. Proventis Partners exclusively advised the owner of IGM throughout the entire M&A process. The services included the preparation of all transaction documentation, the coordination of due diligence and the commercial negotiation of the transaction including an optimal transaction structure.

title: Proventis Partners advised Gurit
description: Carbopress, a specialized Italian company operating in the field of carbon composite components for the automotive industry, has acquired the business of Gurit Hungary. Originally, Gurit planned to discontinue the automotive business. Gurit CEO Rudolf Hadorn explains, “”It’s positive that we were able to find a solution for the employees and the customers.”” Gurit Hungary is a leading Tier 1 automotive supplier to OEMs with Class A carbon fiber-based composite components. With a long history in the production of composites for the automotive industry, Gurit Hungary has established a strong position in the European market segment. The company offers full OEM support from conceptual part design and prototyping, through composite development and production, to the manufacture of Class A parts. Parts are manufactured with a high and increasing level of automation and using state-of-the-art materials. Proventis Partners advised the CEO of Gurit Holding throughout the M&A process. The services provided included the preparation of the complete transaction documentation, the identification and approach of suitable investors and due diligence support.

title: Galledia & BL Verlag
description: The media company Galledia acquires BL Verlag AG, based in Schlieren, to become the largest specialist information provider in the real estate and construction sector. Since its foundation in 1977, BL Verlag has been one of Switzerland’s leading providers of technical and special knowledge. Its portfolio includes five excellent trade and special interest magazines that are well established in the market: at – Aktuelle Technik, Architektur + Technik, idea, Traumhaus and Spectrooms, as well as the associated special supplements and yearbooks. As part of a succession plan, owner and managing director Peter Boll is selling all shares in BL Verlag AG to the media company Galledia with retroactive effect from July 1, 2020. With the trade journals “”IMMOBILIEN Business””, “”intelligent bauen”” and “”der bauingenieur””, Galledia is one of the leading Swiss providers of specialist information in the real estate sector. With the acquisition of BL Verlag AG, Galledia can expand its leading market position and will become the largest provider of qualified specialist information in the fields of real estate and construction.

title: Proventis Partners advised Microdiamant
description: Microdiamant, the “”hidden champions”” of Eastern Switzerland has acquired US-based Eminess Technologies to continue to grow in several dimensions. The company is thus significantly expanding its international presence and its range of products and solutions in one go and secures a key position in high-growth market segments. Founded in 2000, Eminess Technologies has become a technology leader specializing in advanced critical surface polishing consumables and process expertise. Microdiamant is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of solutions for precision surface finishing of high-tech materials. Its products are distributed globally through five company locations and a network of specialized partners in over 40 countries in Europe, the U.S. and Asia. Proventis Partners advised Microdiamant throughout the entire M&A process. Services provided included the financial und qualitative evaluation of Eminess, as well as support during due diligence and negotiation of the transaction.

title: Proventis Partners advised Gurit Holding Ltd.
description: Gurit (SIX Swiss Exchange: GUR) today announced the acquisition of a 60% share of Fiberline Composites A/S, a technology-leading manufacturer of pultruded carbon and glass fiber products used in the wind blade production. The signing took place on April 27, with closing expected before the end of May 2022. Fiberline Composites, headquartered in Middelfart, Denmark, operates production sites in Denmark and China and employs around 300 employees. The company serves major wind turbine OEMs around the world. Founded in 1979, the company recently specialized in pultruded carbon and glass blade spar components and blade root inserts. Fiberline reached annual net sales of CHF 104 million in the calendar year 2021 and is expected to grow its business dynamically as pultruded carbon components are set to replace traditional glass infused spars in longer wind blades. Gurit acquires a 60% equity share of Fiberline from the founding Thorning family for a purchase price of CHF 58 million and additionally approximately CHF 22 million of assumed gross debt for the whole company. Gurit has the right to purchase the remaining shares in the time period from FY 2024 to 2025, at pre-defined commercial terms. Should Gurit at such time however decide not to acquire the remaining 40% of equity share, then the Thorning family has the right to sell the entire company in the market, alternatively. Further details on the transaction will be disclosed in Gurit’s half-year results. The acquisition of Fiberline Composites A/S enhances Gurit’s current product offering into the Wind Energy market of tooling, core materials and core kitting with a major and blade structurally relevant offering of pultruded carbon and glass products. The pultrusion of carbon fiber is a rapidly growing key technology offering significant weight savings versus infused glass solutions and enables both stiffer and lighter wind blades for wind turbines further growing in size. The Fiberline Composites operations will form a new Gurit business unit called Structural Profiles. Operational synergies of co-locating the new Structural Profiles business with existing regional Gurit hubs will be exploited immediately, starting with manufacturing at the Gurit plant in India still in the 2 nd half of this year. Gurit CEO Mitja Schulz says: ‘We welcome our new colleagues from Fiberline Composites to the Gurit family. The joint product portfolio and combined technology and innovation capabilities of both companies allows us to further strengthen our position as one-stop-shop and solution providers for our customers. This acquisition is an important step to fulfill the strategic goals defined in our “One Gurit Strategy 2025′.’ Fiberline Composites A/S chairman Peter Thorning adds: ‘The use of pultrusion in wind turbine manufacturing is increasing rapidly, and the industry needs a strong supply chain.
